name: Webform Send Multiple Emails
description: A Webform email handler that splits a multi-recipient To list and sends each recipient a separate, individually-addressed email.
project_description:
Extends the Webform module "Email Handler" to send multiple emails when multiple recipients are added to the email "to" field.

 Requirements 
 This module requires the Webform module:

 https://www.drupal.org/project/webform 

 Install/Usage 
 
 Install like any other contributed module. 
 Edit any Webform and goto "Settings". Then goto "Emails/Handlers" page. 
 Click on "Add Handler" and find "Send Multiple Emails" handler. 
 Configure handler and test with a Webform submission. 
 Emails sent and should be in your inbox.
